نحق (form I)
# نَحِقُّ (naḥiqqu) /na.ħiq.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# نَحُقُّ (naḥuqqu) /na.ħuq.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# نَحِقَّ (naḥiqqa) /na.ħiq.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# نَحُقَّ (naḥuqqa) /na.ħuq.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussiv
